credit: La Linea — Osvaldo Cavandoli; voice Carlo Bonomi (official Cavandoli site)
authenticity: Short source soundtrack excerpts, stereo downmixed to mono. No synthesis, pitch change, denoising or invented speech. Original source soundtrack preserved. Selection is based on visible mouth/gesture activity and waveform analysis, not an aural audition; emotion labels are gameplay assignments, not verified translations.

playback_policy.selection: Shuffled bags for each game cue; excludes the five most recent clips globally. No automatic playback while walking; one reaction at a time.
playback_policy.gain: One uniform playback gain for the whole atlas; source-relative loudness preserved.
playback_policy.mouth: RMS envelope measured on the actually decoded excerpt.
playback_policy.edge_ramps_note: Gain-only anti-click ramps at playback; the archived source PCM is unchanged.
